chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint moves left and stops in a sandstone corridor as the reload of the M4A1-S rifle begins, with the empty magazine being pulled out. A wall with hieroglyphics is on the left, and an archway leading to a bright courtyard is in the distance.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角在砂岩走廊中向左移动并停止，同时开始重新装填 M4A1-S 步枪，拔出空弹匣。左侧是刻有象形文字的墙壁，远处是一个通往明亮庭院的拱门。
chunks.movement: mixed movement (left strafe -> right strafe -> still)

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint remains still in the sandstone corridor as the reload of the M4A1-S rifle continues with a new magazine being inserted. The hieroglyphic wall and distant sunlit courtyard remain visible.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角在砂岩走廊中保持静止，同时继续重新装填 M4A1-S 步枪，插入新弹匣。象形文字墙和远处的阳光庭院仍然可见。

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint strafes right and turns right as the reload of the M4A1-S rifle is completed with a hand tapping the side of the weapon. The hieroglyphic wall and right-hand pillars shift within the frame.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角向右侧移并右转，同时手部拍击武器侧面完成 M4A1-S 步枪的装填。象形文字墙和右侧的柱子在画面中发生偏移。
chunks.view_change: right yaw turn revealing the right corridor wall

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint continues panning right and strafing right as the M4A1-S rifle is returned to a steady, ready position. The view sweeps to reveal more of the sandstone walls and a corridor opening on the right.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角继续向右平移并向右侧移，同时 M4A1-S 步枪回到稳定的就绪状态。视角扫过，展示了右侧更多的砂岩墙和走廊开口。
chunks.view_change: right yaw turn revealing a sandstone corridor opening

chunks.description_en: The first-person viewpoint performs rapid alternating left and right strafes while holding the fully reloaded M4A1-S rifle in a ready stance. The view faces a sandstone wall and a passage opening on the right under bright daylight.
chunks.description_zh: 第一人称视角进行快速交替的左右侧移，同时将完全装填的 M4A1-S 步枪保持在就绪状态。视角在明亮的日光下朝向右侧的砂岩墙和通道开口。

subject_list.subject_attribute: First-person view of green and white sport gloves holding a white and black M4A1-S rifle with heart and cross decals, with blue sleeves visible.

environment_detail.opening_view: A first-person view looking down a sandy corridor with hieroglyphics carved on the left sandstone wall, a stone archway in the center distance opening to a bright courtyard, and a sandstone wall with columns on the right.
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: The corridor runs straight forward towards an archway, opening to an outdoor courtyard. A right-hand turn or passage is located past the columns on the right, providing alternative cover and routes.
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: Sandy ground with red-striped borders, carved sandstone blocks, weathered plaster, and columns.
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: Stone pillars, carved wall hieroglyphs, and distant trees.
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: Bright daytime sun casting soft shadows on the right wall and sandy floor, with high visibility throughout the corridor.
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: A small green crosshair is visible in the center of the screen. No other HUD elements, health, armor, or ammo counters are visible.

segments.visual_description_long: A first-person view of a sandstone corridor on de_anubis. On the left, a large wall features hieroglyphics. In the midground, a dark stone archway opens to a bright courtyard with distant trees under a blue sky. On the right, another sandstone wall shows a vertical pillar motif. The floor is covered in sand, with a decorative red tile line running along the right side. The warm, bright sunlight enters from the top-right, creating soft shadows. In the foreground, a white rifle with black details is visible, positioned lower in the frame.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> begins to reload the M4A1-S by removing the empty magazine while strafing left and then stopping.</Action1>

segments.visual_description_long: The camera remains stationary in the sandstone corridor. The left wall decorated with detailed hieroglyphic carvings and the central archway leading to the bright sunlit courtyard are still clearly visible in the midground. The right side features the sandstone wall with pillars, casting a shadow on the floor, and a red tiled border runs along the sandy floor. In the foreground, a white rifle is visible in a lowered position. The background courtyard remains bright, with green foliage visible through the doorway, and no other player models are present in the area.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action2><|Subject1|> continues reloading the M4A1-S by preparing and inserting a new magazine while remaining still.</Action2>

segments.visual_description_long: The sandy corridor remains the primary setting. The hieroglyphic wall on the left is close to the camera, while the archway and the right-hand wall with pillars shift positions as the camera moves. The sandy ground with the red tile border remains underfoot. In the foreground, a white rifle is visible in a tilted position. <Camera1> The viewpoint begins to turn to the right, sweeping past the columns on the right to reveal more of the sandstone structures. </Camera1>

contained_actions.action_description: <Action3><|Subject1|> continues reloading the M4A1-S, slapping the bolt release on the receiver while strafing right, looking right, and then strafing left.</Action3>

segments.visual_description_long: The sandstone walls and structures are now framed differently. The hieroglyphic wall on the left recedes slightly, and the central archway is now positioned further to the left of the frame. The sandstone pillars and structures on the right are more prominent. The sandy floor with red tiling remains visible. In the foreground, the white rifle is visible in a steady holding position. <Camera2> The viewpoint continues to sweep to the right, revealing a corridor opening and a large sandstone wall on the right. </Camera2>

contained_actions.action_description: <Action4><|Subject1|> completes the M4A1-S reload, returning the rifle to a ready stance while strafing right and sweeping the view further right.</Action4>

segments.visual_description_long: The corridor view is now pointed towards the right side of the sandstone area. The archway to the courtyard is off-screen to the left. On the right, a corner and stone textures are visible in the bright daylight. The sandy ground with red brick borders is visible below. The white rifle is held steadily in the lower right foreground. The warm sunlight continues to illuminate the stone environment.

contained_actions.action_description: <Action5><|Subject1|> holds the reloaded M4A1-S in a ready stance while performing rapid alternating left and right strafes.</Action5>

subject_list.display_name: 由玩家操控的 CS2 特工
subject_list.subject_attribute: 第一人称视角，佩戴绿白相间的运动手套，手持一把带有心形和十字贴纸的白黑相间 M4A1-S 步枪，可见蓝色袖子。

environment_detail.opening_view: 第一人称视角沿着一条沙质走廊看去，左侧砂岩墙上刻有象形文字，正前方远处有一个石拱门，通往明亮的庭院，右侧是带有柱子的砂岩墙。
environment_detail.layout_and_sightlines: 走廊一直向前延伸到一个拱门，通往室外庭院。右侧柱子后方有一个右转通道，提供了其他的掩体和路线。
environment_detail.surfaces_and_materials: 带有红色条纹边框的沙地、雕刻的砂岩块、风化的灰泥和柱子。
environment_detail.props_and_interactables: 石柱、雕刻的墙壁象形文字以及远处的树木。
environment_detail.lighting_and_visibility: 明亮的日光在右侧墙壁和沙地上投下柔和的阴影，整条走廊的能见度都很高。
environment_detail.hud_and_overlay: 屏幕中央可见一个绿色的十字准星。未见其他 HUD 元素、生命值、护甲或弹药计数。

segments.visual_description_long: de_anubis 上砂岩走廊的第一人称视角。左侧是一面刻有象形文字的大墙。中景处，一个深色石拱门通往明亮的庭院，远处在蓝天之下可见绿树。右侧是另一面展示垂直柱子图案的砂岩墙。地面被沙子覆盖，右侧有一条装饰性的红砖线。温暖而明亮的阳光从右上方照入，投下柔和的阴影。在前景中，可以看到一把带有黑色细节的白色步枪，位置较低。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action1><|Subject1|> 开始重新装填 M4A1-S，在向左侧移然后停止的过程中拆下空弹匣。</Action1>

segments.visual_description_long: 摄像机在砂岩走廊中保持静止。左侧刻有详细象形文字的墙壁 and 通往明亮阳光庭院的中央拱门在中景中仍然清晰可见。右侧是带有柱子的砂岩墙，在地面上投下阴影，一条红砖边界沿着沙地延伸。在前景中，可以看到处于较低位置的白色步枪。背景庭院依然明亮，通过门口可以看到绿色的树叶，该区域没有其他玩家模型。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action2><|Subject1|> 在保持静止的状态下，通过准备并插入新弹匣来继续重新装填 M4A1-S。</Action2>

segments.visual_description_long: 沙质走廊仍然是主要场景。左侧的象形文字墙靠近摄像机，而拱门和带有柱子的右侧墙壁随着摄像机移动而发生位置偏移。带有红砖边界的沙地仍在脚下。在前景中，可以看到一把倾斜的白色步枪。<Camera1> 视角开始向右转动，扫过右侧的柱子，展示出更多的砂岩结构。 </Camera1>

contained_actions.action_description: <Action3><|Subject1|> 继续重新装填 M4A1-S，在向右侧移、向右看然后向左侧移的过程中拍击机匣上的空仓挂机释放键。</Action3>

segments.visual_description_long: 砂岩墙和结构现在的构图有所不同。左侧的象形文字墙稍微退后，中央拱门现在位于画面的更左侧。右侧的砂岩柱和结构更加突出。带有红砖的沙地仍然可见。在前景中，可以看到白色步枪处于稳定的手持位置。<Camera2> 视角继续向右扫过，展示出右侧的一个走廊开口和一面大型砂岩墙。 </Camera2>

contained_actions.action_description: <Action4><|Subject1|> 完成 M4A1-S 的重新装填，在向右侧移并将视角进一步向右扫过的过程中将步枪带回就绪姿态。</Action4>

segments.visual_description_long: 走廊视角现在朝向砂岩区域的右侧。通往庭院的拱门在左侧屏幕外。右侧在明亮的日光下可见一个拐角和石头纹理。下方可见带有红砖边界的沙地。白色步枪稳定地握在右下角前景中。温暖的阳光继续照亮这个石头环境。

contained_actions.action_description: <Action5><|Subject1|> 在进行快速交替的左右侧移的同时，将重新装填好的 M4A1-S 保持在就绪姿态。</Action5>
